caption_used: The character distribution in RoleplayPref is organized into three primary categories — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 subcategories in the outer ring. Virtual Characters occupy approximately 60% of the distribution and are subdivided into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters forming the largest virtual subcategory. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The pie chart represents the distribution of characters in RoleplayPref, categorized into three primary groups: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters. Virtual Characters make up about 60% of the distribution and are further divided into five subcategories: Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters. Movie Characters are the largest subcategory within Virtual Characters. Real Characters account for the remaining 40% and are divided into seven subcategories: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians being the largest subcategory. Custom Characters make up a small portion of the distribution without any labeled subcategories. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific slices. The segments are ordered by category and subcategory, with Virtual Characters and Real Characters being the primary divisions, and the subcategories arranged within these groups.
